name: Run Live Weave and freeze a replayable moment
description: Verifies the primary Live Weave workflow stays ephemeral until an explicit freeze creates the normal replayable session.
steps: Switch from Frozen Weave to Live Weave
Press "Load demo signals" and move the pointer across the large visual field
Increase Working Chat influence and press "Freeze this moment"
expected: The app returns to Frozen Weave with a visible fingerprinted Influence receipt created from the current source state; Live Weave was labeled LIVE / EPHEMERAL before the explicit freeze.

name: Inject a Working Chat signal without restarting Live Weave
description: Verifies a new structured Working Chat packet alters the shared live source state while the presentation remains in Live Weave.
steps: Switch to Live Weave and open "Inject / replace a live packet"
Choose Working Chat, enter a valid JSON packet and provenance
Press "Inject packet" and inspect the Working Chat row and live notice
expected: Working Chat is shown as a ready contributing source with normalized influence, the notice confirms the update happened without restarting Live Weave, and the page remains labeled LIVE / EPHEMERAL.

name: External packet still fails closed without provenance
description: Verifies the v0.5.1 waiting behavior remains harmless while an actually supplied external packet still requires provenance.
steps: In Frozen Weave enable Connector Packet and enter {"signal":0.5} while leaving provenance empty
Inspect the visible capture error and existing frozen state
expected: A visible error says Connector Packet requires provenance and no invalid new frozen session replaces prior state.

name: Internet Eye remains target-blind through live-to-frozen capture
description: Verifies Internet Eye can influence Live Weave without exposing raw indexed targets when the moment is frozen.
steps: In Frozen Weave enable Internet Eye, enter a Shodan-compatible observation containing an IP, hostname, organization and banner, and add provenance
Switch to Live Weave, then press "Freeze this moment"
expected: Internet Eye contributes as an aggregate influence, while the raw IP, hostname, organization name and banner text are absent from the frozen session JSON.

name: Mobile keeps the live visual first and frozen persistence explicit
description: Verifies mobile presents the large live visual before its source controls and retains the existing explicit Frozen Weave persistence workflow.
steps: Switch to Live Weave and confirm the large visual field appears before the source influence controls
Press "Freeze this moment", then "Save session locally"
expected: The mobile Live Weave layout is visual-first, and the resulting frozen session reloads only after the explicit save/load actions with the same visible session fingerprint.
